requirement:
HC's validation policy requires each issue linked by a FIXME to remain open.
A deterministic criterion reads the issue through the SDK's tracked inspection
interface and assesses its supplied status. `Closed` produces a completed
failing assessment; `Open` satisfies this status check. The check does not
require a configured agent.
rationale:
`requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.open` has these testable obligations:

- A deterministic criterion reads the issue through the SDK's tracked inspection interface.
- It assesses the supplied status.
- `Closed` produces a completed failing assessment.
- `Open` satisfies the status check.
- The check works without a configured agent.

`references` returns no `{impl}`, `{test}` or `{cite}` sites for this requirement. There are no tests for any of these obligations. Nothing covers the closed-issue failing assessment, the open-issue pass, or running the check without an agent.

The gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a `{fixme}` on `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes.open` that names `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26`. Its body says the deterministic open-issue criterion is deferred and that tests do not yet verify completed open/closed assessments through the SDK without an agent. That is the same missing-test gap I found. The issue is open: it is the tracking issue for the habeas-sdk work.

The only gap is the one the FIXME acknowledges.
